title: Public portal: choose a visual direction
question: Compare the public water atlas with the research-journal alternative. These are visual concepts, not released functionality.

options.label: Public water atlas
options.thesis: Community reporting, wastewater work and research share one clear geographic index.
options.viewport: A wide annotated watershed drawing anchors a geographic index with a prominent APK download action.
options.risk: Illustrative geography must never be mistaken for live monitoring data.

raised.raise: Actions and evidence classes gain strict separation and visible focus.
Each audience gets an unmistakably named entry point.
The geographic composition remains continuous across the opening.
Reading order becomes a deliberate sequence rather than a card collection.
Version and release state are legible facts rather than decorative numbers.
A limited palette assigns one consistent meaning to each accent.

options.label: Research journal
options.thesis: A carefully edited research portal introduces the tools through evidence and plain language.
options.viewport: A strong masthead and asymmetric editorial contents place download and account actions beside a clear platform introduction.
options.risk: Familiar academic editorial styling could make the mobile app feel secondary.

options.label: Dark developer console
options.thesis: Translate the source grammar into the three platform journeys.
options.viewport: An isolated release action in a graphite panel index.
options.risk: Dense tool grammar makes public onboarding harder.
options.case: Public citizens identify less with developer tooling; panel navigation obscures the platform introduction.

options.label: Loteria tabla
options.thesis: Translate the source grammar into the three platform journeys.
options.viewport: A numbered table of downloads, workspace and research.
options.risk: Game associations can weaken scientific interpretation.
options.case: Citizen recognition and evidence clarity are weaker than the atlas.

options.label: Sleeping city fold
options.thesis: Translate the source grammar into the three platform journeys.
options.viewport: Folded districts lead to community reports and research.
options.risk: Dream imagery can imply unsupported flood conditions.
options.case: Surreal geography weakens both regional recognition and factual clarity.

options.label: Hand-processed film
options.thesis: Translate the source grammar into the three platform journeys.
options.viewport: A sequence of reporting, analysis and publications.
options.risk: Photographic effects can disguise evidence quality.
options.case: Film treatment is less identifiable and makes source status harder to scan.

options.label: Nixie laboratory counter
options.thesis: Translate the source grammar into the three platform journeys.
options.viewport: Release and account entry points occupy a laboratory counter index.
options.risk: Glowing counters could resemble measured live values.
options.case: Instrument symbolism is less familiar to citizens and obscures action hierarchy.

options.label: CRT arcade
options.thesis: Translate the source grammar into the three platform journeys.
options.viewport: A strict tile index organizes the three platform journeys.
options.case: Gaming identification and pixel text weaken audience fit and reading clarity.

canonCard.label: Conventional platform portal
canonCard.thesis: A familiar product introduction leads directly to downloads, accounts and research.
canonCard.viewport: A straightforward introduction, visible primary download action and clear product navigation.
canonCard.risk: The composition deliberately resembles other software portals.
